meta.description: PRV-03. Sub-workflow, called via Execute Workflow from pipeline-delivery.json's ADDITIVE 'prd_sign approved/signed?' branch (never triggered by its own webhook -- pipeline-delivery.json already owns POST ev/pipeline.gate.decided, and n8n allows exactly one active workflow per webhook path; a second trigger on the same path would silently steal or fail to claim it). Inputs (Define Below): tenantId (string), runId (string). Body: calls the hub tool webdev.provisionSite as wf:delivery (OBO). That call is write:true/impact:'medium', so the D14 gate SUSPENDS it for a human approval every time an automation principal calls it with no grant -- design section 04's stated contract is that 'suspended_for_approval' (detected via the hub's 'suspend: ...' isError text, the SAME shape pipeline-delivery.json's own deploy.production branch already parses) IS the success outcome here, not a failure. On suspend this sub-workflow files the WS4 approval itself via approvals.request (already allow-listed for wf:delivery) so a human sees it in the approvals inbox; D14's executor re-drives the ORIGINAL webdev.provisionSite call (as the wf:delivery principal) if/when a human approves, re-deriving the run + prd_sign-gate precondition at that time (platform-nest core/approval-executables.ts, PRV-03 entry) rather than trusting this moment's state. A non-suspend isError is a genuine failure (hub down, workflow de-scoped, tool bug) and is notified, not silently dropped. Output (Return node): { ok, action: 'provision_suspended'|'provision_failed'|'provisioned', approvalId?, error? }. Env: HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, NOTIFY_USER_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "webdev.provisionSite", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, runId: $json.runId, framework: "vite" } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 2, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "approvals.request", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, workflowId: "wf:delivery", toolName: "webdev.provisionSite", toolArgs: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, runId: $json.runId, framework: "vite" }, impact: "medium", reason: $json.reason } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 3, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, recipientId: $env.NOTIFY_USER_ID, type: "provision_propose_failed", payload: { runId: $json.runId, reason: $json.reason } } } }) }}
